recap.text:
Newport Select Gold 14U In Control In Victory Over WR Sting
October 24, 2026 vs. WR Sting
Newport Select Gold 14U were in control the entire time on Saturday versus WR Sting. Newport Select Gold 14U never trailed in their 42-30 victory.
Leading 10-8, Newport Select Gold 14U went on a 12-point run to pull further away. Newport Select Gold 14U got out to a 27-11 lead at halftime before closing out the victory.
The first quarter was the best for Newport Select Gold 14U as they outscored WR Sting 27-10. Newport Select Gold 14U had five assists in the quarter.
Aiden Ng was the leading scorer for Newport Select Gold 14U with nine points. Newport Select Gold 14U passed the ball well with 11 assists on 16 made baskets. Newport Select Gold 14U swiped 16 steals in the game. Ng led the team with five steals. Charles led Newport Select Gold 14U with five rebounds. Additional scorers for Newport Select Gold 14U included Harry Zhang (8 points), Kalden Sen (8 points), Talen Tep (5 points), Deacon Chun (5 points), Charles (5 points), and Uttam Verriach (2 points).
WR Sting shot well from distance, going 2-6 from three. WR Sting had a great day shooting from inside the arc, finishing 8-16 on twos.
